scientific_integrity: Analytic proof included; independent validation not performed; original external papers and indexed closest mathematics compared by full relevant sections.
scientific_limitations: Three radial Zernike modes; two disjoint squared-radius intervals; q to zero only. Sharp leading least-eigenvalue asymptotic and necessary limiting geometry, not exact finite-area optimizer or unconstrained E-optimal design. Finite tests are not general proofs. Historical equivalence cannot be ruled out by database searches.
title: Sharp small-aperture E-observability with two radial Zernike bands
